package access

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/plystra/authn/accountstore"
	"github.com/plystra/authn/passwordhash"
	"github.com/plystra/data/database"
	"github.com/plystra/data/postgres"
	compiler "github.com/plystra/data/postgres/compiler"
	"github.com/plystra/kernel/configuration"
)

func TestGeneratedAccountsPostgres(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	resolver, err := configuration.NewResolver(configuration.ResolverOptions{MaximumValueBytes: 4096})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	reference, err := configuration.NewEnvironmentReference("AUTHN_ACCOUNTSTORE_TEST_DATABASE_URL")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	secret, err := resolver.Resolve(ctx, reference)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("disposable AUTHN_ACCOUNTSTORE_TEST_DATABASE_URL is required")
	}
	backend, err := postgres.New(postgres.Config{URL: secret, MaxConnections: 4, HealthTimeout: 5 * time.Second})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := backend.Start(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if err := backend.Stop(context.Background()); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	})
	model, err := accountstore.Accounts.Normalize()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	const identity = "data/f1ea98fb38bf"
	migrations, err := compiler.CompileMigrations([]compiler.SchemaMember{{MemberID: "authn.accounts/v1", Resource: "database.authn", Model: model}}, identity, compiler.MigrationHistory{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	approval, err := backend.MigrationPlan(ctx, identity, migrations)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := backend.ApplyMigrations(ctx, identity, approval.PlanDigest, migrations); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	provider, err := New(backend)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var resource accountstore.Resource = provider
	if _, err := New(nil); !errors.Is(err, database.ErrUnavailable) {
		t.Fatal("missing database Resource accepted")
	}
	hasher, err := passwordhash.New(passwordhash.Options{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	password := []byte("public generated provider test password; never a deployment secret")
	phc, err := hasher.Hash(ctx, password)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	prefix := strings.ToLower(rand.Text())
	request := func(suffix, email string) accountstore.StageRegistrationRequest {
		return accountstore.StageRegistrationRequest{AccountID: prefix + "-" + suffix, OperationID: prefix + "-op-" + suffix,
			NormalizedEmail: email, PasswordPHC: phc, RequestDigest: bytes.Repeat([]byte{9}, 32), NowUnix: time.Now().Unix()}
	}
	email := prefix + "+tag@example.test"
	first := request("first", email)
	output, err := resource.StageRegistration(ctx, first)
	if err != nil || output.AccountID != first.AccountID || output.OperationID != first.OperationID || output.SubjectRevision != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("typed plan outputs did not commit correctly: %v", err)
	}
	record, err := resource.FindRegistration(ctx, accountstore.FindRegistrationRequest{OperationID: first.OperationID})
	if err != nil || record == nil || record.AccountID != first.AccountID || record.Status != "pending" || record.ProvisioningState != "pending-provisioning" || record.SubjectRevision != 1 || record.CreatedAtUnix != first.NowUnix || !bytes.Equal(record.RequestDigest, first.RequestDigest) {
		t.Fatalf("typed reconciliation query lost facts: %v", err)
	}
	record.RequestDigest[0] ^= 255
	record, err = resource.FindRegistration(ctx, accountstore.FindRegistrationRequest{OperationID: first.OperationID})
	if err != nil || record == nil || !bytes.Equal(record.RequestDigest, first.RequestDigest) {
		t.Fatal("request digest escaped storage ownership")
	}
	credential, err := resource.PasswordForEmail(ctx, accountstore.PasswordForEmailRequest{NormalizedEmail: email})
	if err != nil || credential == nil || credential.AccountID != first.AccountID || credential.Status != "pending" || credential.ProvisioningState != "pending-provisioning" || credential.SubjectRevision != 1 || credential.ContactVerified || credential.CredentialRevision != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("typed password query lost safety facts: %v", err)
	}
	match, err := hasher.Verify(ctx, password, credential.PasswordPHC)
	if err != nil || !match.Match {
		t.Fatal("typed password PHC does not verify")
	}
	duplicate := request("duplicate", email)
	output, err = resource.StageRegistration(ctx, duplicate)
	if !errors.Is(err, database.ErrConflict) || output != (accountstore.StageRegistrationResult{}) {
		t.Fatal("duplicate email published a typed partial result")
	}
	missing, err := resource.FindRegistration(ctx, accountstore.FindRegistrationRequest{OperationID: duplicate.OperationID})
	if err != nil || missing != nil {
		t.Fatal("later contact conflict left an account")
	}
	output, err = resource.StageRegistration(ctx, first)
	if !errors.Is(err, database.ErrConflict) || output != (accountstore.StageRegistrationResult{}) {
		t.Fatal("operation replay silently succeeded")
	}
	if missing, err := resource.PasswordForEmail(ctx, accountstore.PasswordForEmailRequest{NormalizedEmail: prefix + "-absent@example.test"}); err != nil || missing != nil {
		t.Fatal("zero-or-one missing query mismatch")
	}

	start := make(chan struct{})
	type outcome struct {
		request accountstore.StageRegistrationRequest
		result  accountstore.StageRegistrationResult
		err     error
	}
	outcomes := make(chan outcome, 2)
	for _, suffix := range []string{"race-a", "race-b"} {
		go func() {
			candidate := request(suffix, prefix+"-race@example.test")
			<-start
			result, err := resource.StageRegistration(ctx, candidate)
			outcomes <- outcome{candidate, result, err}
		}()
	}
	close(start)
	successes := 0
	for range 2 {
		item := <-outcomes
		stored, err := resource.FindRegistration(ctx, accountstore.FindRegistrationRequest{OperationID: item.request.OperationID})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if item.err == nil {
			successes++
			if stored == nil || stored.AccountID != item.result.AccountID {
				t.Fatal("concurrent typed success was not stored")
			}
		} else if (!errors.Is(item.err, database.ErrConflict) && !errors.Is(item.err, database.ErrConcurrent)) || item.result != (accountstore.StageRegistrationResult{}) || stored != nil {
			t.Fatal("concurrent failure published a partial typed result")
		}
	}
	if successes != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("typed unique winners = %d", successes)
	}
	cancelled, stop := context.WithCancel(ctx)
	stop()
	candidate := request("cancelled", prefix+"-cancelled@example.test")
	output, err = resource.StageRegistration(cancelled, candidate)
	if err == nil || output != (accountstore.StageRegistrationResult{}) {
		t.Fatal("cancelled typed call returned success")
	}
	if missing, err := resource.FindRegistration(ctx, accountstore.FindRegistrationRequest{OperationID: candidate.OperationID}); err != nil || missing != nil {
		t.Fatal("cancelled typed call left an account")
	}
}
